target.formula: D_K(t) = cached Utility(TopK,t) - cached Frozen-selected Utility(t)
target.reasonForFourOutputs: Frozen selected is not a Top-N prefix. D5 is needed as well as the three incremental layers. D10-D5 = U10-U5, etc. No new input feature or ranking change.

utility.quote: max(upExcursion,downExcursion)*10000 - 10; opportunity proxy, not realized P&L
utility.missingTargets: No imputation. Each regression uses finite paired D_K. Report/evaluate on common active decision support: baseline and all four U_K finite, independent of chosen action.
utility.abstain: Preserve Frozen ABSTAIN. Exclude from utility means; include all decisions in counts and jumps. No new outcome-selected abstention.
utility.candidateWeighting: Equal among observed available candidate labels within each decision; missing per-symbol denominator counts are unavailable.
utility.timestampWeighting: Equal among paired observed decisions within each session
utility.trainingWeighting: Equal available paired decisions per target; scaler uses all past causal-feature-ready rows
utility.costDifference: The identical 10 bps subtraction cancels in D_K; do not subtract it again.
utility.baselineCorrection: v2.1 used U(frozenSelectedCount) in its metric. v2.2 uses the stored frozenSelectedUtility field. v2.1 result remains unchanged.
limitations: Frozen-selected cache omits labels outside ranks 1..20 and missing horizon labels. Full-selected utility is not recoverable without more raw data.
Cached source prefixIdentity is not symbol-level historical evidence; v2.2 prefix identity is enforced by rank-index slice construction and adapter tests.
Raw per-symbol missing counts and target end timestamps are unavailable. No raw-PIT re-audit claim.

cv.lambdaSelection: For each target and outer train cutoff, use only inner blocks with testEnd <= outer trainEnd; minimize session-equal paired MAE; ties choose smaller lambda.
cv.scaling: Fit independently on each inner train; refit only on each outer past train; never global scale before evaluation.
cv.mapping: Precommitted fixed prediction floor -10 bps. No threshold fit, no quantile grid, no outer-label-driven mapping.
cv.pastOnly: Fit, scaling and lambda selection receive ONLY preceding-session records; decision inference receives only four features, frozenSelectedCount and rankedCount.
cv.purge: Whole-session train/test separation. Original missing purge session retained. Horizon labels are same-session and same-segment; prior session closed before next session decisions. Additional whole-session embargo=0.
cv.outerResultsUse: Gate evaluation only; no architecture or threshold retries after results.
cv.interpretation: Algorithmically forward-only predictions. Architecture was designed using previously opened Development evidence; blocks are NOT an untouched independent test.

mapping.choice: Largest allowed K <= rankedCount whose predicted D_K >= -10; if none qualifies choose Top5. If rankedCount <5 choose ABSTAIN. Preserve Frozen ABSTAIN. Missing features force ABSTAIN and fail feature coverage gate.
